headline: Government of India files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for Indian Railway Finance Corporation
sum: The Ministry of Railways has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers), 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding or acquisition intent in IRFC by or on behalf of the Government.
detail: IRFC, a wholly Government-owned financial institution under the Ministry of Railways, has been the subject of a substantial acquisition disclosure filed by the Government itself on 16 June 2026. The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code is a mandatory filing whenever an acquirer, whether individual, corporate or sovereign, crosses the 25% threshold or intends a material acquisition. This disclosure is the formal trigger for the takeover process and must be accompanied by detailed particulars of the acquirer, target, consideration and timing. Given IRFC's status as a railway PSU, this filing likely relates to capitalisation, privatisation planning, or a related-party transaction requiring regulatory clearance.
